ticker: Wall Street suffers worst slump since 2020
Dalal Street hits ₹500 lakh cr milestone
Delhi AQI reaches severe levels at 389

articles.headline: Wall Street Tech Stocks Suffer Worst Slump Since 2020
articles.brief: US markets experienced a severe market selloff, wiping out $3 trillion as AI trade fears and potential new regulations triggered massive stock declines across major indices.

articles.headline: Dalal Street Market Capitalisation Crosses ₹500 Lakh Crore
articles.brief: The Bombay Stock Exchange market capitalization officially crossed the monumental ₹500 lakh crore milestone, driven by robust IPO activity and a steady post-Diwali economic recovery.

articles.headline: Adani Ports Acquires Dutch Storage Operator Evos
articles.brief: India's Adani Ports has finalized a deal to purchase Dutch liquid bulk storage operator Evos in an international acquisition valued at $2.88 billion.

articles.headline: Delhi Air Quality Reaches Severe Levels at 389 AQI
articles.brief: Delhi's air quality index touched 389 with several areas entering the severe zone, prompting local discomfort, breathing complaints, and blame targeted at ongoing regional stubble burning.

articles.headline: Paraguay President Santiago Peña Impeached After Bank Collapse
articles.brief: Paraguayan lawmakers voted 78-0 to impeach President Santiago Peña following widespread protests triggered by the sudden collapse of Ueno Bank, which froze millions of citizen savings.

articles.headline: Cristiano Ronaldo Announces Retirement From International Football
articles.brief: Portugal football legend Cristiano Ronaldo has officially announced his retirement from international play, concluding a historic career that brought his home nation three major international trophies.

articles.headline: Wisconsin Reports First Measles Death in 36 Years
articles.brief: Health officials confirmed the death of an infant from measles in Wisconsin, marking the state's first fatality from the preventable virus in over three decades amid surging anti-vaccine sentiment.

articles.headline: Israel Intelligence Claims Iran Developing Chemical Weapon Delivery Systems
articles.brief: Israeli intelligence has reportedly warned US counterparts that Iran is rapidly advancing technology to deploy chemical weapons via missiles and drones or smuggle them for external attacks.

articles.headline: India Defies Asia Tech Rout Through Strong Foreign Buying
articles.brief: Indian equity markets successfully defied the broader Asian tech sector selloff, cushioned by a slide in global oil prices and sustained foreign institutional buying.

articles.headline: France Sees Massive Protests as 575,000 Demonstrate Across Cities
articles.brief: An estimated 575,000 demonstrators took to the streets across France in the largest wave of civil unrest since September, resulting in clashes with police forces in Paris and Lyon.

articles.headline: Cellophane Bees Produce Biodegradable Polymer Nest Linings
articles.brief: Scientific researchers have discovered that ground-nesting cellophane bees secrete a translucent, resilient material that acts as a natural, rapidly degrading plastic alternative.

articles.headline: Elon Musk Deletes Pro-Republican Social Media Posts
articles.brief: Billionaire entrepreneur Elon Musk deleted posts supporting Republican candidates on X following major Democratic victories in the US midterm elections after spending heavily on campaigns.

articles.headline: India and Philippines in Final Talks for Expanded Missile Sale
articles.brief: Diplomatic sources confirm that India and the Philippines are in the final stages of negotiations to expand ongoing defense agreements regarding advanced missile exports.

articles.headline: AI Trade Volatility Sparks Security Concern for Wall Street
articles.brief: The ongoing technology sector correction has prompted intense financial discussions among market analysts and investors as high-flying AI stocks undergo heavy profit-taking.

articles.headline: Jamie Dimon Vows Opposition to Yield-Paying Stablecoins
articles.brief: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon has signaled continued resistance against regulatory allowances for yield-paying stablecoins, citing heightened financial risk to traditional banking.
